rationale: All four prior findings are addressed by the fix-up diff (202 lines): CR-001 regex now /^\s*<.../; CR-002 the PostCompact scan skips boundaries whose uuid was inherited and restarts when the parent lookup resolves late; CR-004 the clamp was tried and removed (D-11) because it can move Started later; CR-003 was accepted by the user and recorded as D-10. Three regression tests were verified to fail on the pre-fix code and pass now; the transcript test directory passes (385 tests) and tsc is clean. The diff introduces no new data-loss, security or contract risk, so no confirmation pass was needed.
